cohort_definition: w1/extra/final count records encoded in those committed CBs; when all ready in first cold cohort, all count under final, not again under w1.
limits: CPU extra tag is sampled BEFORE commit, same MoE epoch as read ends; never aligned to Metal.
After-all-read excludes outstanding SSD workers at commit only; CPU tail encoding can still overlap.
Before-last-read tag does not establish GPUexec during SSD IO.
Metal gaps pair consecutive commands in same clock only; not devicewide idle or recoverable durations.
Two intrusive native8 runs, not a speed campaign.
